description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of different reasoning methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across varying token counts, with the accuracy values displayed on the left y-axis and token counts on the right y-axis. The x-axis lists the four methods, each represented by a distinct colored bar: CoT (red), CoD (orange), CCoT (light blue), and CoUT (green). The accuracy values for each method are as follows: CoT at 91.19%, CoD at 80.89%, CCoT at 88.40%, and CoUT at 91.19%. The corresponding token counts are 676.85 for CoT, 534.24 for CoD, 445.91 for CCoT, and 354.46 for CoUT. The bars are arranged in descending order of accuracy, with CoT and CoUT having the highest accuracy, followed by CCoT, and CoD having the lowest. The chart visually emphasizes that CoT and CoUT achieve the highest accuracy, while CoD has the lowest, with token counts increasing in the same order as accuracy.
